'''Brogol''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who led the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] as the [[Sovereign Magnate]] by [[3628 BBY]]. He eventually negotiated the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] exit from a treaty with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
